resolution x = 1280

camera sensitivity = 0.5

local self=require('openmw.self')
local types=require('openmw.types')
local nearby=require('openmw.nearby')
local core=require('openmw.core')
local t=0
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function(dt)
 t=t+dt;if t<.2 then return end;t=0
 assert(not types.Actor.isDead(self),'Player died on first Kvatch gate approach')
 if self.position.x < -140000 and self.position.y > -20000 and self.position.y < -14000 then
  local gate=nearby.getObjectByFormId(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x01e8a3))
  print('KvatchApproach staged original marker position='..tostring(self.position)..' gateValid='..tostring(gate:isValid()))
 end
end}}}}
